findingDetails.title: Command caller migration still contains removed worktree assumptions and raw state writes
findingDetails.evidence: The auto review branch rejects shared checkout and appends recovery state directly; related review/research branches retain divergent inline containment paths.
findingDetails.recommendation: Migrate all four command YAMLs to the current shared-checkout, gateway-only contract and remove the obsolete worktree preflight.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Some branches already use shared-checkout inputs, but the explicit rejection and raw append remain.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Phase 007 and its acceptance criteria explicitly cover command YAML migration.

findingDetails.title: Canonical packet records disagree about isolation state
findingDetails.evidence: Goal and accepted ADRs say isolation is off or removed, while parent requirements and closure records still describe worktree default-on behavior.
findingDetails.recommendation: Declare one post-ADR-007 contract authoritative, supersede obsolete requirements and acceptance rows, and reconcile summary/handover claims.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Some statements can be historical, but they are not consistently marked as superseded on the closure surface.
findingDetails.scopeProof: All cited files are canonical packet state surfaces.

findingDetails.title: Churn threshold rationale contradicts executable defaults
findingDetails.evidence: Rationale says 12 per heartbeat and 40 cumulative; REQ-004 and executor-config ship 3 and 12.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reconcile the rationale, requirement, schema defaults, and acceptance evidence to one explicit threshold set.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The executable schema is unambiguous, but the operator-facing rationale is not marked obsolete.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The thresholds govern shared-checkout safety and are specified in the target packet.
